# `shade.clear_sharp`: Clear sharp

Clears the sharp mark from edges so shading flows smoothly across them.

- Category: shade
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n) for the selector plus O(E) to count
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: clear sharp, soften edges, soft edge, polySoftEdge 180

The opposite of `shade.mark_sharp`. Without a selection every edge becomes smooth (a fully smooth-shaded object).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Edges (faces select their edges, vertices the edges between them); every edge when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3): cleared 16 sharp edges (0 sharp in all)`
